summary: Iteration 2 — Verified production build fix (yarn build) + full runtime regression. `CI=true yarn build` exits 0 with 'Compiled successfully.' Built /app/frontend/build/index.html is a single well-formed document (1 <html>/<head>/<body> pair, 0 chars after </html>) and contains JSON-LD @graph with Gurgaon locality. Runtime: Home renders hero heading 'Design. Build. Market. Scale.' + both badges ('Available · Jan 2026' AND 'Based in Gurgaon · Open to relocate worldwide'). Hero quote form and Contact form both POST /api/leads successfully and persist to Mongo. All 9 backend pytest tests pass. Zero console errors across Home/About/Services/Work/Blog/Contact.
critical_code_review_comments: public/index.html rewrite is clean — no stray content, well-formed structure verified in build output (6460 bytes, single doc).
JSON-LD @graph correctly ships in build/index.html with Person, WebSite, ProfessionalService entities and Gurgaon PostalAddress — good for SEO.
Two Tailwind arbitrary-value ambiguity warnings during build (duration-[1200ms], ease-[cubic-bezier(...)]) — cosmetic only, not blocking. Consider quoting brackets to silence.
Carried over from iteration_1: GET /api/leads is still unauthenticated and exposes lead PII. Recommend admin auth before production.
Carried over: Hero portrait Unsplash image is still a placeholder (unrelated person).
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_-prefixed leads during this iteration (1 backend pytest + 2 UI submissions from Hero and Contact). All 3 cleaned up post-test via db.leads.delete_many.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Production build (yarn build) verified working — exit 0, valid HTML output, JSON-LD @graph intact. Backend suite: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (9/9 pass). Site is now positioned as 'Based in Gurgaon · Open to relocate worldwide' — both hero badges render. TEST_-prefixed leads are safe to clean via Mongo delete_many.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the original bug (html-minifier-terser parse error) was duplicate garbled content after </html> in public/index.html. Fix (rewrite) is verified: build succeeds and output index.html has 0 bytes after </html>. No regressions in runtime or API behavior.
